name: dg-submissions: the #app gate takes the submissions list for Cloudflare's check
why: The submissions list is plain HTML without #app; only a page with neither #app nor #page_content is the check.

name: dg-submissions: our section inside Discogs' #main_wrapper
why: Without #app, header and page share #main_wrapper; the sticky headers pin every other <body> child whole, so our section must be one.

name: dg-submissions: the pages asked without view=flat
why: The browser view's list has no release ids: every page is read as the flat view.

name: dg-submissions: Artist and Title not split
why: vzell 2026-10-18: "Artist - Title" split at the first " - " into two columns.

name: dg-submissions: the unlabelled fourth cell (the matched artist) dropped
why: Discogs' flat row has a fourth cell without a header: the list's artist the release matched.

name: dghistory: the reader never takes a history link
why: The Discogs reader's path pattern takes /history too; the history reader must come first and claim it.

name: dghistory: the card reads the history on a hover
why: windowOnly: only Space reads the edit history (mockup tab C), never a hover.

name: dghistory: on discogs.com through GM_xmlhttpRequest, not the browser's session
why: On discogs.com the history page is a same-origin fetch() with the session that passed Discogs' browser check.

name: dghistory: the cache key keeps the link's slug
why: A history link and a release title share one request: the key is the release's canonical history URL (keyUrl).

name: dghistory: the diff shows every block, marked or not
why: The latest change shows only the blocks Discogs marked, unless "The whole release" is pressed.

edits.find: const shown = ui.diffAll ? diff.blocks : diff.blocks.filter(b => b.changed);

name: dghistory: a release's window on the submissions list without its history
why: vzell 2026-10-18: "History, then the release" for a title on this page.

edits.find: if (dg.kind === 'release' && _dgOnSubmissions()) out.top = _extDgHistReleaseParts(t, dg.id, { start, force, repaint });

name: dghistory: the history drawn under the release, not above it
why: A window's top part goes ABOVE the two columns.

name: full-size viewer: the row's record never asked
why: A row's full images come from its record, asked for when the viewer shows the row.

name: full-size viewer: the arrived images never shown
why: _artViewerReplaceImages() swaps a row's thumbnail for its full images in place.

edits.find: if (!st || st.ctx !== ctx || st.entityPath !== entityPath || !images.length) return;

name: full-size viewer: Try again does nothing
why: A failed row offers "Try again", which asks once more.

name: dg-submissions: the matched artist linked by name again
why: Discogs' name link (/artist/<name>) has no id: no reader takes it. A search link, as the Artist column (vzell 2026-10-18).

name: dg pages: Discogs' input[type=search] content-box wins over the column filters
why: discogs.css (the older pages) makes our width-100% filters content-box: ~86 px past each column (vzell, debug/stretch.html).

name: dg Changed time: no Time of day section
why: On discogs.com a dateTimeParts time column gets "Time info - Time of day" (vzell 2026-10-18).

name: dg avatars: a submissions user's picture never asked
why: vzell 2026-10-18: each user's own picture; asked when its row comes on screen.

name: dg avatars: the picture inside the name's link
why: A link around an image is the image's (_extTarget()): the name's preview would be lost.

name: dghistory: the users' pictures not read from the history page
why: The history page carries each user's picture: no request needed.

name: dg-submissions: the browser view's body not tagged for the scroll unlock
why: subbrowser.css's body rule (overflow hidden, height 100%) reaches the viewport: the window cannot scroll, the table stops at its edges.

name: dg-submissions: the scroll unlock rule left out of the style
why: The tag alone changes nothing: the rule must override Discogs' own body rule.

name: dg-submissions: every Discogs page tagged for the scroll unlock
why: Only the split pane's page needs it; the rest keep Discogs' own layout.
